uri.description: LDAP server URIs (space-separated in template); support multiple for redundancy

base_dn.description: Default base distinguished name (DN) for LDAP searches and operations

cacert_path.description: Path to CA certificate file (e.g., /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt) for TLS verification

client_cert.description: Path to client certificate file for mutual TLS (leave empty to disable client auth)

client_key.description: Path to client private key file (must match client_cert); required if client_cert is set

tls_protocol_min.description: Minimum TLS protocol version in hex (e.g., '0x0303' for TLS 1.2); empty = system default

search_timelimit.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for search operations (0 = unlimited)

search_sizelimit.description: Maximum number of entries returned by a search (0 = unlimited)

referrals.description: Automatically chase referrals (e.g., to other LDAP servers)

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity (0–7); 0 = no debug, 7 = maximum detail

network_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for network connection before timing out
